characters.appearancePrompt: Caucasian male, silver-frosted temples, high forehead with faint subdermal lattice implants (visible only under UV), eyes unnervingly symmetrical—pupils dilate *in unison* even under shifting light, lips slightly overfilled with collagen-mimetic dermal filler, posture rigid yet fluid like a motion-captured deity
characters.clothingPrompt: Custom NEXUS Executive Weave suit—self-adjusting charcoal wool blended with piezoelectric thread that emits faint red bioluminescence along seam-lines when lie-detection algorithms activate; no tie, top two buttons undone to reveal a subclavicular neural sync port sealed with biogel; left wrist wears a vintage analog chronometer frozen at 00:00:72
